project_title: Rita Sharma — Premium Personal Brand Landing Page for Life Insurance Advisor
archetype: Architectural / Swiss Editorial & High-End Financial Personal Brand
theme: Light mode primary (Warm Cream & Alabaster Canvas with Deep Navy / Charcoal Typography and Champagne Gold Accents)
data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, toggles, badges, card actions) MUST include data-testid in kebab-case e.g. data-testid="hero-talk-to-rita-button"

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#0B132B] leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.section_h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-[#0B132B] leading-[1.2]
hierarchy.eyebrow_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-sans font-semibold text-[#C5A059]

hero_portrait.description: Editorial portrait of Rita Sharma in professional navy blazer with arms crossed, high-trust studio background
hero_portrait.placement: Hero right-hand visual spotlight card with subtle gold border frame and badge overlay

about_portrait.description: Rita Sharma seated in consultation posture with warm approachable stance

lifestyle_young_family.description: Happy modern young family outdoors enjoying peaceful moments
lifestyle_young_family.placement: Why Insurance protection feature narrative card

kathua_jammu_landscape.description: Serene northern Indian landscape symbolizing stability and roots
kathua_jammu_landscape.placement: Location banner background overlay with dark navy backdrop filter

required_sections.name: Navigation Header
required_sections.description: Glassmorphism sticky header (`backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF8F5]/85 border-b border-[#E2DACF]/60`), brand mark 'RITA SHARMA • Life Insurance Advisor', desktop nav links (About, Why Insurance, Why Rita, Calculator, Manifesto, Location, FAQ), and CTA 'Talk to Rita' linking to WhatsApp.

required_sections.name: Kinetic Hero Section
required_sections.description: Headline: 'SECURE YOUR FAMILY'S TOMORROW, TODAY.' Supporting line: 'Smart protection for the people, plans and future that matter most.' Dual CTAs ('Talk to Rita' + 'Get a Free Consultation') both linking to WhatsApp https://wa.me/917889789814 with custom message. Hero right side displays Rita Sharma's portrait in an editorial rounded frame with glowing gold outline badge '15+ Years Trust • Kathua & Pan-India'.

required_sections.name: Editorial Marquee
required_sections.description: Slow organic drift ticker featuring low-contrast warm gold background: '15+ YEARS EXPERIENCE • 1000s OF FAMILIES PROTECTED • PERSONALIZED GAP ANALYSIS • PAN-INDIA DIGITAL CONSULTATION • ZERO CONFUSION GUARANTEE'.

required_sections.name: About Section
required_sections.description: Title: '15+ YEARS OF TRUST. ONE SIMPLE PROMISE.' 4 Key Stats: 15+ Years Experience / 1000s of Families / Personalized Guidance / Pan-India Consultation. Narrative paragraph detailing Rita's background based in Kathua, Jammu & Kashmir, serving clients nationwide with honesty and care.

required_sections.name: Why Insurance Section
required_sections.description: Title: 'YOUR FUTURE DESERVES A PLAN.' 4 Core Points: 1. Protect your income. 2. Secure your family's lifestyle. 3. Keep your children's dreams on track. 4. Create a financial safety net. Quote highlight box: 'Insurance isn't about expecting the worst. It's about being prepared for whatever life brings.'

required_sections.name: Why Rita Section
required_sections.description: Title: 'INSURANCE, WITHOUT THE CONFUSION.' 4 Key Benefits: 1. Personalized financial gap analysis. 2. 15+ years of practical experience. 3. Guidance through policies and claims. 4. Simple, convenient digital process.

required_sections.name: Interactive Financial Gap Calculator
required_sections.description: Custom interactive tool allowing users (young professionals, parents) to input annual income, dependents, existing loans, and children's education milestones to calculate their ideal term insurance coverage gap with instant WhatsApp consultation trigger.

required_sections.name: Manifesto Chapters
required_sections.description: Numbered editorial chapters (01. Protection Before Speculation, 02. No Jargon Policy, 03. Lifelong Claim Assistance, 04. Remote & On-Demand across India) styled with large serif chapter numbers and rich typography.

required_sections.name: Trust Signals & Client Stories
required_sections.description: Curated testimonials and scenarios from millennials, young parents, and business owners across Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Jammu, and Kathua praising Rita's jargon-free, objective advice.

required_sections.name: Location Banner
required_sections.description: Header: 'Based in Kathua, Jammu & Kashmir • Advising clients across India'. Subtext: 'Whether you're in Jammu, Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru or anywhere else in India, you can connect with Rita for personalized insurance guidance.' Includes interactive city pill selectors.

required_sections.name: Final CTA & Custom Plan Form
required_sections.description: Headline: 'DON'T WAIT FOR THE "RIGHT TIME".' Subheadline: 'Protect what you've worked hard to build.' Form fields: Name, Age, Mobile Number, Coverage Goal. Action button: 'REQUEST MY CUSTOM PLAN' which opens WhatsApp with prefilled parameters.

required_sections.name: Floating WhatsApp Badge
required_sections.description: Fixed bottom-right button linking to https://wa.me/917889789814?text=Hi%20Rita,%20I%20would%20like%20to%20schedule%20a%20free%20insurance%20consultation with pulse animation.

required_sections.name: Footer
required_sections.description: Minimal editorial footer with disclaimer ('Rita Sharma is an authorized Life Insurance Advisor. Advice is tailored per individual financial profile.'), quick links, location details, and copyright.

motion_and_animations.framer_motion_effects: Staggered fade-up entrances, subtle parallax on hero visual frame, hover scale (1.02) on interactive cards, glow border transition on active input fields
motion_and_animations.kinetic_text_reveal: Line-by-line slide and opacity reveal on hero headline

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design DOES NOT look like traditional LIC/government sites (no corporate blue/yellow, no cliché shields, no ugly red/yellow tables). Maintain an Awwwards-level luxury personal brand aesthetic.
Strictly follow the light editorial palette: Cream background (#FAF8F5), Deep Navy typography (#0B132B), and Warm Champagne Gold accents (#C5A059).
All CTAs must direct users seamlessly to WhatsApp (https://wa.me/917889789814) with context-specific prefilled messages.
Add testid attributes (`data-testid="..."`) to all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive widgets.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is flawless with responsive font clamping and generous spacing.
